messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: unusual per-model token rate for model family ozone-7b detected. 5xx risk increasing. auto-mitigation candidate: per-model rate-curtail. see /incidents/1934567890
maria: on it. seeing spike in tpm to ~14k, sustained over 90s. overall cluster TPS climbing, some tail latencies >1s. tagging @ashwin @jess
ashwin: ack. is this traffic coming from a single customer or many? Any unusual path? dashboard looks like generation endpoint v1/chat with long context.
maria: quick dig — top 3 customers account for ~72% of recent tokens. one looks like a batch job hitting retry loops. request sizes ~3-4k tokens.
jess: can you pull the request ids? I want to check for function-calls floods. also confirm model precision variant (fp16 vs int8)
maria: grabbing logs now. sample request id: req_0a9f3e. model: ozone7b-std (fp16). no function call spam in payload; it's long single-turn prompts.
opsbot: runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/per-model-rate-mitigation (recommended: temporary tpm/rpm sculpt, enable stricter per-customer quotas)
luke: short-term mitigation: lower ozone7b TPM/RPM to protect shared capacity and push some traffic to ozone7b-quant (compatible). We should avoid full disable if customers rely on it.
ashwin: agree. propose cutoff: tpm 2500, rpm 8000 for ozone7b-std. and set route policy to fallback to ozone7b-quant when requests exceed per-customer threshold.
maria: timeline: apply change in 60s if no objections. will monitor E2E and SLO graphs.
product-ops: need a heads-up for customers using ozone7b-std with high throughput. we'll draft a short note if this goes into effect >5m.
jess: quick sanity: will quant variant be compatible for all customers? some rely on fp16 for slight quality differences.
luke: quant is slightly lower quality on rare cases but generally compatible. we can whitelist specific enterprise customers to skip fallback if they have contracts.
maria: executing mitigation now.

# command
redwoodctl quota update --model ozone7b-std --tpm 2500 --rpm 8000 --reason "emergency sculpt: sustained spike" 

maria: applied. confirmed via API: ozone7b-std {tpm:2500, rpm:8000}
opsbot: change propagated to edge nodes in 12s. config version: cfg-2026-06-12-483
maria: immediate effect: inbound token rate dropped ~60% for ozone7b-std. cluster load stabilizing.
ashwin: checking customer impact: first-pass: 3 customers throttled to error 429 intermittently. sending list to product-ops.
product-ops: received. prepping comms: short advisory + recommended usage patterns. will flag any SLA customers.
jess: metrics to watch: 95p latency, kv cache hit rate, retry loops, queue depth. pls post graphs.
maria: posting charts: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/ozone7b/1934567890
luke: ok, next steps: 1) escalate whitelist requests for any enterprise impacted 2) run analysis to see if we can shift noncritical traffic to quantized pool 3) schedule a 1hr follow-up postmortem
sre-next: i'm taking the 30m handoff. will keep watch and escalate if oscillations resume.
maria: handoff notes:
- mitigation applied at 1934567890
- current quotas ozone7b-std tpm=2500 rpm=8000
- fallback route to ozone7b-quant enabled on route policy rp-ozone-fallback
- impacted customers: cust_alpha (high volume batch), cust_gamma, cust_delta (all notified)
- logs: sample req_0a9f3e points to bot job retry; suggest customer success outreach
jess: please capture the exact rollback commands in runbook
maria: rollback snippet added to runbook. snippet:
```
# rollback
redwoodctl quota update --model ozone7b-std --tpm 12000 --rpm 45000 --reason "rollback after mitigation"
```

maria: leaving thread, assigning to @sre-next. I'll be reachable if needed.
sre-next: ack, monitoring. will run additional token-sampling over next 15m and update.
product-ops: following up on customer comms. will coordinate whitelist requests and escalate to account team if SLA concerns.
ashwin: follow-up engineering action: add per-customer exponential backoff detection rule to prevent future retry storms. filed ENG-11234.
luke: good. set tentative postmortem 2026-06-12 16:00 UTC. include runbook gaps and fallback quality notes.
sre-next: no new spikes in 25m. keeping quotas as-is for now. will update again at +60m.
product-ops: will draft public status line in case customers hit 429s. keep me posted before any further changes.
maria: thanks team. closing live mitigation window. leaving notes in incident ticket: INC-1934567890. :white_check_mark:
